validation.mechanical_boundary: Every field named test must be a unique repository-relative tests/**/*.py::test_name node collected by pytest.
validation.semantic_boundary: Resolution does not prove the surrounding claim. Reviewers must read the referenced assertions and narrow or remove any unsupported prose.

real_toolchain_journey.unavailable: controlled skip with capability names in pytest output
real_toolchain_journey.boundary: The test exercises the external adapters only when every named executable resolves; it does not prove the full document lifecycle.
